title: PSVR2 Headset Not Recognized
shortDescription: PS5 fails to detect connected PSVR2 headset.
fullDescription: Error CE-117773-6 indicates the PS5 cannot establish a USB-C link with the PSVR2. Caused by loose cable, damaged USB-C port, or firmware mismatch after PS5 update.

fixSteps.title: Reseat USB-C
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug and reinsert PSVR2 cable into front USB-C of PS5.

fixSteps.title: Update firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Accessories > PlayStation VR2 > System Software.

faq.a: PSVR2 cable is integrated; damage requires headset service.

title: PSVR2 Tracking Lost
fullDescription: PSVR2 uses 4 onboard cameras for tracking. Error CE-118802-7 is shown when tracking fails due to lighting, dirty lenses, or featureless rooms.

fixSteps.title: Add lighting
fixSteps.instruction: Aim for evenly lit room without direct sun on cameras.

fixSteps.title: Clean cameras
fixSteps.instruction: Microfiber cloth on the four front cameras.

fixSteps.title: Re-run play area
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Accessories > PSVR2 > Adjust Play Area.

faq.a: No, inside-out tracking needs visible features.

title: PSVR2 Sense Controller Won't Pair
shortDescription: Sense controllers do not connect to PS5.
fullDescription: Pairing failures often follow a firmware update or low battery. Reset via the small button on the back of each controller.

fixSteps.title: Charge controllers
fixSteps.instruction: Use charging dock or USB-C cables for 30 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Reset controller
fixSteps.instruction: Insert pin into back hole, hold 5 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair via cable
fixSteps.instruction: Connect to PS5 with USB-C and press PS button.

faq.a: Some menus accept it but VR gameplay needs Sense controllers.

title: OLED Mura Streaks Visible
shortDescription: Vertical streaks or color banding in dark scenes.
fullDescription: PSVR2 OLED panels have inherent mura (luminance non-uniformity). Severe mura is a hardware issue eligible for replacement under warranty.

causes.cause: Brightness too high in dark scenes

fixSteps.title: Reduce brightness
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Accessories > PSVR2 > Brightness, lower one notch.

fixSteps.title: Disable HDR
fixSteps.instruction: Toggle HDR off in PSVR2 video settings.

fixSteps.title: Warranty exchange
fixSteps.instruction: Request replacement at playstation.com/support if severe.

faq.a: Mild mura is panel-tech normal; heavy banding is not.

title: PSVR2 Eye Tracking Setup Fails
fullDescription: Eye tracking requires correct IPD, clean lenses, and lashes not touching the lens. Glasses can also defeat calibration.

fixSteps.title: Adjust IPD
fixSteps.instruction: Use the dial on the headset bottom while wearing it.

fixSteps.title: Use lens spacers
fixSteps.instruction: Install glasses spacers if you wear glasses.

faq.a: You can, but lose foveated rendering performance.

title: PSVR2 Headset Too Hot
shortDescription: Headset shuts off due to high temperature.
fullDescription: Long sessions in warm rooms can overheat the PSVR2. Ventilate room, take breaks, and ensure the headband vents are not covered.

causes.cause: Vents blocked by hair or pad

fixSteps.title: Cool room
fixSteps.instruction: Run AC or fan; ideal under 25C / 77F.

fixSteps.title: Clear vents
fixSteps.instruction: Verify side vents are not obstructed by pad foam.

faq.q: Can I add a fan mod?
faq.a: Aftermarket fans exist but void warranty.

title: PSVR2 Earbuds No Sound
fullDescription: Audio output uses 3.5mm jack on the headset. Issues are usually loose plugs or wrong audio routing in PS5 settings.

fixSteps.title: Set audio device
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Sound > Audio Output > Output Device > PSVR2 Headset.

faq.a: PS5 only allows licensed BT audio; PSVR2 jack is recommended.

title: VR Game Failed to Launch
fullDescription: CE-117813-9 occurs when launching a PSVR2 game without the headset on or with stale game cache.

fixSteps.title: Wear headset
fixSteps.instruction: Put on PSVR2 before pressing X to launch.

faq.a: Usually only the title that failed to load.

title: Flat Games Look Blurry on PSVR2
fullDescription: In cinematic mode the PS5 outputs a 1920x1080 virtual screen scaled across the OLED. The result looks softer than native VR. Adjust IPD and screen size for sharpness.

fixSteps.title: Tune IPD
fixSteps.instruction: Adjust IPD dial until text is sharp.

fixSteps.title: Reduce screen size
fixSteps.instruction: VR Control Center > Cinematic Mode > Screen Size > Medium.

faq.a: No, it's a limitation of cinematic mode rendering.

title: PSVR2 Causes Nausea
shortDescription: User feels dizzy or sick during VR.
fullDescription: Motion sickness in VR comes from frame drops or smooth locomotion. Use comfort settings, take breaks, and ensure 90 FPS performance mode.

fixSteps.title: Enable comfort settings
fixSteps.instruction: Switch movement to teleport and add vignette.

fixSteps.title: Use performance mode
fixSteps.instruction: Select 90/120 FPS performance mode in game options.

faq.a: Many users adapt within a few weeks of regular use.
